title: Devastator: The Tantive Capture
description: A 160-stud Imperial dagger with smooth armor panels, deep mechanical trenches, eight octuple batteries, three open ion-drive bells, twin geodesic shield domes and a tiny Tantive IV beneath its illuminated ventral bay. Two narrow black cradles leave the silhouette unobstructed.

sections.name: Dagger hull and mechanical edge trenches
Command bridge and twin geodesic shield generators
Three ion drives and four auxiliary thrusters
Captured blockade runner and display cradles
